verdict.rationale: Granola documents a public RESTful API that gives programmatic access to workspace meeting notes, transcripts and AI summaries, with user API keys and non-expiring workspace API keys for admins on Business and Enterprise plans. The evidence only describes reading and accessing data, not driving product actions, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: evidence of write or action endpoints (e.g. creating notes or triggering workflows), a published OpenAPI/endpoint reference, and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.
